comment: A sandstone pyramid (0.8488): a sealed golden chest on a pedestal (a golden key opens it, and only from up close: CHEST_UNSEAL_REACH), ringed by sandstone pressure plates buried in sand over TNT. In the Desert and the Red Sand, not their hills nor the deep deserts; on red sand it is built of red sand and red sandstone (spawn.replace by biome). The Deep Desert gets its own, bigger one.
